metadata.description: Typed personal relationships, inverse semantics, group membership and life events inspired by Monica

Group.description: Relationship context, such as a family or team

parentOf.description: Identifies the subject person as a parent of the target person in the recorded context; the inverse declaration does not create a childOf edge.

childOf.description: Identifies the subject person as a child of the target person in the recorded context; the inverse declaration does not create a parentOf edge.

friendOf.description: Records a friendship between people. Symmetry is declared, but neither a reciprocal friendOf edge nor a knows edge is automatically inferred.

knows.description: Records a directed acquaintance relationship from one person to another; reciprocal acquaintance or friendship requires its own evidence.

memberOf.description: Records a person's membership in a group with the required role in that group context; the role is not a global property of the person.

partOfOrganization.description: Identifies an organization to which a group belongs; the link does not automatically assign the group's members to that organization.

worksAt.description: Records a person's work affiliation with an organization in the cited context; a particular job role or team membership requires separate evidence.

participatedInLifeEvent.description: Identifies a person who participated in a life event; participation does not imply a particular role or a relationship with every other participant.
